mainDressCode.title: Dress Code
mainDressCode.description: We kindly request our guests to dress in elegant, formal attire to celebrate our special day.

sections.title: PARENTS AND PRINCIPAL SPONSORS
sections.description: We would love to see our parents and principal sponsors in barong and filipiniana.

sections.title: ENTOURAGE
sections.description: We would love to see our groomsmen in black vests with red bow tie, and our best of honor and flower girls in formal dresses with a touch of pink.

sections.title: GUEST ATTENDEES
sections.description: We would love to see our guests in semi-formal attire in burgundy, red, or black to match our celebration theme.
